serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: This won’t go away. We got paid really well to find out what happened and our client wants at least one head to roll.
Policeman: Do you understand now? It doesn’t matter if you did it or not. As long as you are our only lead, we are going to hunt you until you confess or give us some info about what happened!
Melissa: I already told you everything I knew. Many times. Now, if you excuse me…
Policewoman: Not so fast.
Policeman: Do you know what happens with such augmented freaks like you in prison? Everything is cool and dandy until one day you wake up and all your shiny parts are gone! 
Policeman: How about I give you a little sneak peek of what’s to come?
Policewoman: That’s enough.
Policeman: What?! We were just getting to the good part!
Policewoman: Someone’s watching us.
Policeman: You were lucky today, but we will be back.
